content.title: About
content.content: Enchilada is a ready‑to‑eat Mexican snack consisting of a corn tortilla filled with seasoned meat, cheese and spices, covered with a chili sauce. The product is sealed in a vacuum‑packed pouch and is designed for quick heating in a microwave or oven.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Enchilada originated in Mexican cuisine over 500 years ago as a way to use leftover meat.
The NFS (Ready‑to‑Serve) version uses pre‑cooked meat, reducing preparation time to 3‑5 minutes.
The traditional chili sauce contains natural spices such as cumin, oregano and smoked paprika.
The product is often included in quick‑lunch kits for schools and offices.
Enchilada can be served hot or cold as a snack.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: The meat filling provides 10‑12 g of protein per serving, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Red meat and chili sauce are rich in heme iron, which contributes to normal blood formation.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The product supplies vitamin B12 and niacin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: No added sugars are used in the recipe, making it suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: Cheese adds calcium, supporting bone health.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: The chili sauce and processed meat contain salt; people monitoring sodium intake should limit portions.

items.title: Heat treatment
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave bacteria; heat the product to an internal temperature of 75 °C.

items.title: Gluten in tortilla
items.content: Some variants use wheat flour in the tortilla, making the product unsuitable for gluten‑free diets.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the pouch in a microwave (800 W ≈ 3‑4 min) or in an oven (180 °C ≈ 10‑12 min). Serve with fresh salsa, guacamole or sour cream. Optionally garnish with fresh vegetables or herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place at 5‑25 °C. After opening, keep the product in an airtight container in the refrigerator and consume within 2‑3 days.
